name: dsmnru-pyq-android
description: Capacitor Android shell for the DSMNRU PYQ website (https://dsmnru-pyq.netlify.app). The app renders the existing production frontend inside a native Android WebView — no second backend, no bundled copy of the site.
author: DSMNRU Academic Archive

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
